integrity.method: Algebraic proof and exact-rational reproducibility test; no external proof certification or independent validation.
integrity.proof_domain: Every finite dimension at least two with linearly independent snapshots; a three-dimensional sharp witness.
integrity.verification: verify.py uses Python standard-library exact Fractions and 9250 deterministic rational tests.

limitations: The theorem treats two independent snapshots, affine symmetric positive-definite matrices, and a fixed right-hand side. Positivity outside the snapshot interval is not generally ensured; positivity for arbitrary higher-rank bases is not claimed. Historical priority beyond inspected literature is not independently established.
title: Exact two-snapshot Galerkin cone law and sharp extrapolation positivity failure
